page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead DevOps Transformation & Platform Engineering Leader
headline: Lead DevOps Transformation & Platform Engineering Leader | Enterprise CI/CD, DORA Metrics, SAFe & SRE
summary_html: Transformation-oriented DevOps and Platform Engineering Leader with 12+ years of technology delivery, engineering leadership, and large-scale cloud transformation experience. Proven track record operating at both strategic roadmap and hands-on execution levels to establish governance, drive Agile/SAFe adoption, and accelerate DevOps maturity across complex enterprise environments. Expert in architecting modern CI/CD ecosystems across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, EKS, AKS, Docker). Champion of DORA engineering metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, CFR, MTTR), Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), shift-left testing, and developer experience (DevEx) optimization. Exceptional stakeholder manager, facilitator, and executive communicator who bridges deep technical engineering with quantifiable business outcomes, vendor governance, and cross-functional team enablement.

achievements.text: Defined and executed multi-year enterprise DevOps transformation roadmaps, aligning engineering capabilities with executive business priorities to modernize delivery architectures across distributed organizations.
Established automated DORA metrics tracking—elevating deployment frequency from bi-weekly to on-demand, cutting lead time for changes by 65%, and reducing change failure rate to under 2%.
Consolidated fragmented toolchains across GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps into standardized, self-service CI/CD pipelines with shift-left testing and security governance.
Governed delivery priorities and technical roadmaps within SAFe enterprise frameworks, coordinating cross-team dependencies, mitigating delivery risks, and resolving architectural impediments.
Spearheaded organizational change management and established an enterprise DevOps Community of Practice (CoP), facilitating executive reviews, architecture workshops, and continuous learning.

Governed cross-team delivery dependencies and technical risks within SAFe/Agile release trains, facilitating alignment between engineering squads, architects, and business stakeholders.
Spearheaded shift-left testing and security integration, embedding automated static code analysis, container vulnerability scanning, and secrets management directly into PR validation.
